title: Special Civil Maintenance to Lighthouse Tower and allied buildings including improvement of Internal Roads/Pathways and provision of Bio-toilets at Kuthenkuli Lighthouse in Chennai Directorate.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate, two-cover) for special civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower and allied buildings, improvement of internal roads/pathways and provision of bio-toilets at Kuthenkuli Lighthouse, Tirunelveli District, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate); deadline extended to 19.05.2025.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Kuthenkuli Lighthouse, Kuthenkuli, Tirunelveli Dist, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Special civil maintenance to tower and allied buildings, improvement of internal roads/pathways, provision of bio-toilets

scope.item: Special Civil Maintenance to Lighthouse Tower and allied buildings including improvement of Internal Roads/Pathways and provision of Bio-toilets

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; validity three months (table) / 90 days (clause 1.1) from technical bid opening; exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works in last seven years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; completed works only; value updated at 7% p.a.; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of buildings or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC works
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution

Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), non-blacklisting affidavit, declaration of relatives in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)

corrigenda.change: Extension of last date (administrative reasons): online bid submission extended to 19.05.2025 15:00; bids opened 20.05.2025 15:00 (originally 08.05.2025 / 09.05.2025)

notes: Scanned Section I NIT only; no BOQ or bio-toilet specification. Original download/submission 18.04.2025 10:00 to 08.05.2025 15:00; EMD up to 08.05.2025 15:00; opening 09.05.2025 15:00. Spelled 'Kuthenkuli' in NIT (listing: Kuthenkuli). Corrigendum signed by Deputy Director for Director. Listing end date 2025-05-08 is the original deadline; listing opening 2025-05-27 matches neither the NIT nor the corrigendum (possibly a later extension not in the listing documents).
